sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Design student Gargi Agrawalla has won this year's UK James Dyson Award with a device that uses artificial intelligence to alert deaf and hard-of-hearing users of important sounds like knocks or fire alarms, which they might otherwise miss. More than 500 samples were used to train the SIVO.GO system so it can recognise these noises The post AI-powered alarm for deaf people wins UK James Dyson Award appeared first on Dezeen .
